origins.section: Prune a Node That Is Infeasible, Integral, or Cannot Beat the Incumbent
The Optimum Always Lies Between the Incumbent and the Best Waiting Bound
With Whole-Number Values, Round the Bound Down Before Comparing

recorded.prompt:q-which-branch:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-which-branch:a: bound | z(F_0, F_1) \le \underline{z} | no plan below is worth more than the incumbent. A's 3,180 is at or below 3,200, so A is pruned.
recorded.prompt:q-which-branch:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-which-branch:c: integrality | the LP solution is all 0 and 1 | it is the best plan in the node; it becomes the incumbent if it beats it. C is a leaf, not branched on.
recorded.prompt:q-which-branch:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-which-branch:d: A node is **pruned** ... for exactly three reasons ... Every other node is branched on.
recorded.prompt:q-range:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-range:a: The incumbent's value \underline{z} is below it. The lower end is the incumbent's 9,400, not the lowest node bound.
recorded.prompt:q-range:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-range:b: \bar z = \max(... \max_{waiting nodes} bound(n)). The top is the largest waiting bound, 9,700.
recorded.prompt:q-range:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-range:c: When the two meet, the incumbent is proven optimal. Here they have not met (9,700 > 9,400).

recorded.prompt:q-whole-values:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-whole-values:b: With Whole-Number Values, Round the Bound Down Before Comparing. The test is \lfloor z \rfloor \le \underline{z}.
recorded.prompt:q-whole-values:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-whole-values:d: "The **incumbent** is the best real plan the search has found so far: a 0-1 plan that obeys every row." A node with a fractional variable is not a plan.
